rows.role_title: Acting State President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: Proclamation No. 167, 1989, fixing 20 September 1989 for the commencement of the Diplomatic Immunities and Privileges Act, 1989, was given at Cape Town on 13 September 1989 and signed by F. W. de Klerk as Acting State President (published in the Gazette of 19 September 1989).
